command:
set -e
for f in /opt/300seconds/jetson/*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done
shellcheck /opt/300seconds/jetson/*.sh
systemctl is-active --quiet ssh.service
systemctl is-active --quiet NetworkManager.service
systemctl is-active --quiet automagic-fan.service
systemctl is-active --quiet nvargus-daemon.service
printf 'GUI: '; systemctl is-active gdm.service || true
printf 'Default: '; systemctl get-default
printf 'Rollback timer: '; systemctl is-active 300seconds-mode-rollback.timer || true
printf 'bnep: '; if [ -d /sys/module/bnep ]; then exit 1; else echo absent; fi
printf 'nvgpu: '; test -d /sys/module/nvgpu; echo present
printf 'ROS key: '; test ! -e /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg; echo inactive
printf 'ROS marker: '; test -f /var/lib/300seconds/ros-disabled/disabled; echo present
printf 'PackageKit APT hook: '; cat /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20packagekit
printf 'Current SSH groups: '; id -nG jetson
printf 'Final shell and essential-service checks passed\n'
stdout:
GUI: inactive
Default: multi-user.target
Rollback timer: inactive
bnep: absent
nvgpu: present
ROS key: inactive
ROS marker: present
PackageKit APT hook: // PackageKit APT notifications paused by 300seconds project mode.
Current SSH groups: jetson adm dialout cdrom sudo audio dip video plugdev i2c lpadmin gdm lightdm gpio weston-launch sambashare jtop
Final shell and essential-service checks passed
